floater.name: chat_upload
floater.title: Chat images
floater.text: Anyone with the link can view this image.

check_box.name: save_gif
check_box.label: Save GIF uploads to My GIFs
check_box.tool_tip: Save confirmed GIF links as bookmarks. Files can still expire or be cleaned up.

text.name: retention
text.tool_tip: Files last up to 180 days and may be cleaned up earlier. Original files can retain embedded metadata.

floater.text: Public links can expire. Original files can retain metadata.

check_box.name: automatic
check_box.label: Upload future pasted/dropped images without asking
check_box.tool_tip: Chat still requires Send. Change this later in Preferences → Chat → Media → Uploads.

button.name: retry
button.label: Retry…
button.tool_tip: Review failed or uncertain uploads before trying again. An uncertain upload may already exist on the server.
